description:
The generic parent. It carries the rules that make sense in a repository with no code at all:
        managed files, the committable tree, formatting of committed text, typography, agent entry
        files, the suppression ceiling, software refused by name, licenses, freshness, known
        vulnerabilities, the software bill of materials, the compliance report, history, commit
        messages, secrets, shell scripts and infrastructure.

        A repository with no code, or a monorepo root, inherits this one directly. A Java module
        inherits airness-parent-java, which inherits this one and adds the Java rules.
